시편 133:1.content: A Song of degrees of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

시편 133:2.content: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron’s beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;

시편 133:3.content: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the Lord commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.
